segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What happens when a founder meets an investor who sees an entirely different risk?

segments.speaker: founder
segments.text: Our first thousand customers arrived without a paid campaign.

segments.speaker: investor
segments.text: That is promising, but how many of them are still using the product?

segments.speaker: analyst
segments.text: We should inspect the data before making any claims.

segments.speaker: reporter
segments.text: And what should people look at first?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The answer is not simply growth. It is what that growth means.
